statements.label: Assertion A
statements.text: In equation $\Delta_\mathrm{r}G = -nFE\_cell$, value of $\Delta_\mathrm{r}G$ depends on $n$.

statements.label: Reasons R
statements.text: $E\_cell$ is an intensive property and $\Delta_\mathrm{r}G$ is an extensive property.

options_en.2: Both A and R are true and R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
options_en.3: A is true but R is false.
options_en.4: A is false but R is true.
